ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW: Resolve version_bump open question with a definitive choice

Convert the 'Version bump question' bullet from open question to a binary done definition: e.g., 'Version bump is performed by a CI Action triggered after PR merge to main; merge-to-main.sh PR mode does not invoke version bump. The --bump flag is accepted for backward compatibility but logs a deprecation notice and is a no-op.' Or alternatively: 'merge-to-main.sh PR mode performs version bump on the feature branch as a final commit before opening the PR.' Update end-session SKILL.md and sprint SKILL.md accordingly.
